Owen Wister, The Virginian.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/owen-wister/the-virginian

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Owen Wister, the author and the writer of a preface, died 1938 (Wikidata Q1281119, P570 = 1938-07-21; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Owen_Wister).

First publication of the text used: 'The Virginian was published in 1902 by Owen Wister.' (SE colophon).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1902, before 1929. Works published before 1929 entered the United States public domain by 1 January 2025, and Standard Ebooks states the same in its rights statement (below).
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1938 or earlier, and the facts give no link to France, Spain, Mexico, Colombia or Russia/USSR. The text is in English, so the possible countries of first publication are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less, which had passed for a death in 1938 (the last to die was Owen Wister, P570 = 1938-07-21). So the text is public domain there whichever of these countries it was first published in.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
